lineage.description: Food security statistics were aggregated from FSNWG quarterly reports covering nine Eastern African countries from December 2010 to January 2015. Data represents post-event and ongoing food insecurity impact assessments compiled from regional humanitarian assessments, with spatial assumptions documented in accompanying shapefile.
